t: A BeagleBone Linux board with Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth for connecting sensors to networks.
steps: Look for leftover stock at Seeed Studio, RobotShop, or DigiKey. It was about 79 US dollars at Seeed.
Power it with a 12 V supply or a 5 V micro-USB cable.
Connect an Ethernet cable or join your Wi-Fi.
Log in to the BeagleBoard Debian image that comes on the eMMC.
Follow the Seeed wiki to flash a newer image from a microSD card.
Install Adafruit Blinka and run a Python blink example.
Plug in a Grove sensor and print its readings.
meta: Open Board. From $78.90. A few stores.
